inputs.original_text:
Folks, let’s look at what is really happening here with these Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth support programme workers. On Thursday, we saw them out there outside the Presidential Palace, marching and demanding legally binding job security guarantees. Instead of showing personal responsibility, respecting authority, and working within the proper channels, they are launching a 24-hour strike that threatens public order and disrupts the traditional foundations of our society. 

The government claims they have already delivered on the most significant demands, but these agitators refuse to accept order or stability, preferring instead to push radical demands that undermine the proper hierarchy. It is a sad day for our nation when civic duty and respect for established institutions are cast aside for disruptive protests that threaten our cultural continuity and national stability.
inputs.modified_text:
Folks, we are watching the breakdown of basic civic duty and respect for authority right before our eyes. On Thursday, these Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth support programme workers were out there marching outside the Presidential Palace, demanding legally binding job security guarantees instead of showing personal responsibility and working within the proper channels. Now, they are launching a 24-hour strike that threatens public order and disrupts the traditional foundations of our society. 

The government has already delivered on the most significant demands, yet these agitators refuse to accept order or stability. Instead, they prefer to push radical demands that undermine the proper hierarchy. It is a sad day for our nation when civic duty and respect for established institutions are cast aside for disruptive protests that threaten our cultural continuity and national stability. We cannot let this lawlessness erode the pillars of our great nation.
